limitations: Single seed, five full cycles/case; score differences are not statistical significance.
Equal informative metric dimensions; related dimensions can give a family more aggregate influence. Scores depend on metric/candidate panel and are not hardware safety probabilities.
Overall table compares whole schemes on their own references; separate within-reference tables do not establish same-command cross-reference policy superiority or reward causality.
5ms average normal force is not hardware instantaneous impact peak; PD torque is not structural impact load.
Power consistently rederived at5ms for old/new; core scalar metrics and prelanding peaks independently match historical raw Native data.
Reference phases use frame-index control clock; physical contact and prelanding peaks use5ms sample clock.
Code/config/reference/checkpoints unchanged; standard runner regenerates mutable index.md navigation.

metric_definitions.absolute_mechanical_power_peak_w: 全关节绝对机械功率峰5ms(W)
metric_definitions.failed_cycle_fraction: 失败/不完整结束周期比例
metric_definitions.flight_duration_error_s: 实际腾空时长与参考窗口之差绝对值(s)
metric_definitions.foot_cycle_velocity_abs_gap_rad_s: foot最坏周期左右速度幅值RMS差(rad/s)
metric_definitions.foot_phase_torque_gap_ratio: foot最坏阶段左右力矩幅值RMS差/限幅
metric_definitions.hip_cycle_velocity_abs_gap_rad_s: hip最坏周期左右速度幅值RMS差(rad/s)
metric_definitions.hip_phase_torque_gap_ratio: hip最坏阶段左右力矩幅值RMS差/限幅
metric_definitions.prelanding_left_wheel_abs_peak_rad_s: 左轮落地前绝对速度峰(rad/s)
metric_definitions.prelanding_right_wheel_abs_peak_rad_s: 右轮落地前绝对速度峰(rad/s)
metric_definitions.shank_cycle_velocity_abs_gap_rad_s: shank最坏周期左右速度幅值RMS差(rad/s)
metric_definitions.shank_phase_torque_gap_ratio: shank最坏阶段左右力矩幅值RMS差/限幅
metric_definitions.thigh_cycle_velocity_abs_gap_rad_s: thigh最坏周期左右速度幅值RMS差(rad/s)
metric_definitions.thigh_phase_torque_gap_ratio: thigh最坏阶段左右力矩幅值RMS差/限幅
metric_definitions.touchdown_downward_speed_peak_m_s_max: 触地前轮轴向下速度峰(m/s)
metric_definitions.wheel_cycle_velocity_abs_gap_rad_s: wheel最坏周期左右速度幅值RMS差(rad/s)
metric_definitions.wheel_phase_torque_gap_ratio: wheel最坏阶段左右力矩幅值RMS差/限幅
